# Chi-Square {#chi-square}

*This chapter has not been written yet.*

Tests for counts in categories. You build the chi-square statistic from observed and expected counts: for each category, the squared difference between the observed and expected count, divided by the expected count, then added up across categories. The goodness-of-fit test compares one categorical variable with expected proportions, and the test of independence asks whether two categorical variables are related.
